title: Oracle cast expansion
note: Twenty four new character cards for the tarot deck. Four cast sheets, six cards each, generated in the same Mucha style as oracle-cast-01..04. Names are printed by scripts/import_expansion_cards.py, never by the image model.

cards.name: Zagreus
cards.fate: A son may inherit a kingdom without inheriting its verdict.
cards.description: Deal 3 damage to a chosen foe. Every ending sends him back to the fight.
cards.art: a young man with short black hair and a crimson shoulder mantle, bronze sword lowered, embers under his sandals, pomegranate branches behind him, red and gold palette

cards.name: Nyx
cards.fate: The dark that shelters you is the same dark that hides your enemy.
cards.description: Raise a ward that absorbs 5 damage from the next enemy turn.
cards.art: a tall veiled woman in indigo robes scattered with small stars, great dusk-coloured wings folded behind her, a crescent moon held like a lamp, night sky inside the arch, deep blue and silver palette

cards.name: Thanatos
cards.fate: Mercy and death can arrive in the same hand.
cards.description: Deal 4 damage and delay the target's next attack.
cards.art: a pale young man with long silver-white hair and folded black wings, holding a slim scythe in one hand and a butterfly on the other, cypress trees and a grey field behind him, ivory and charcoal palette

cards.name: Megaera
cards.fate: A punishment repeated often enough becomes a habit of the punisher.
cards.description: Deal 4 damage to a chosen foe.
cards.art: a fierce winged woman in dark bronze armour with a red-plumed helm, coiled whip in her raised hand, torches and smoke behind her, crimson and bronze palette

cards.name: Hypnos
cards.fate: Forgetting is a kindness until someone asks you to remember.
cards.description: Restore 3 Will and let the party set down some of its weariness.
cards.art: a sleeping youth with a wreath of poppies, small wings at his temples, leaning on a stone by a slow river, reeds and drowsy mist, lavender and pale gold palette

cards.name: Chaos
cards.fate: Before the first law there was room for anything, including a different ending.
cards.description: Spend 1 Thread to deal 5 damage. Without Thread, deal 3 and gain 1 Burden.
cards.art: a faceless figure wrapped in drifting mist and layered violet veils, two open hands framing a ring of tiny stars, no face visible, void and dust behind, violet and pale gold palette

cards.name: Achilles
cards.fate: The one place you refuse to guard is the place that will be found.
cards.description: Deal 4 damage to a chosen foe.
cards.art: a bronzed warrior in plumed helm and myrmidon armour, long ash spear planted, shield at his side, sea cliffs and ships behind him, copper and sea blue palette

cards.name: Patroclus
cards.fate: To be remembered well is to be mourned twice.
cards.description: Restore 4 Will and steady the party's nerve.
cards.art: a gentle bearded man seated on a stone, offering a shallow cup, laurel wreath, linen chiton, olive trees and a quiet camp behind him, cream and olive palette

cards.name: Sisyphus
cards.fate: Repetition is not defeat while the will to lift remains.
cards.description: Raise a ward that absorbs 4 damage from the next enemy turn.
cards.art: a worn man with a narrow bronze crown shouldering a great round boulder on a steep slope, patched chiton, tunnelled rock behind him, ochre and iron palette

cards.name: Charon
cards.fate: Every crossing has a price, and the price is never the one you planned.
cards.description: Deal 3 damage and delay the target's next attack.
cards.art: a hooded ferryman in a long grey cloak with a lantern and a long pole, small boat on still black water, one bronze coin held out, ash and slate palette

cards.name: Eurydice
cards.fate: What grows in the dark still grows toward something.
cards.description: Restore 4 Will.
cards.art: a dryad crowned with poplar leaves holding a small lyre, wheat and fern around her, pale green light from above, spring green and ochre palette

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.fate: A guard that never sleeps forgets what it is guarding.
cards.description: Raise a ward that absorbs 5 damage from the next enemy turn.
cards.art: a great three-headed hound with a gold collar seated before a bronze gate, pomegranates and bones at its paws, charcoal fur, smoke behind, charcoal and bronze palette

cards.name: Theseus
cards.fate: Certainty is a wall, and walls decide who is inside.
cards.description: Raise a ward that absorbs 4 damage from the next enemy turn.
cards.art: a proud young king in a short crowned helm and white chiton, sword point down and round shield forward, marble columns and olive branches behind him, cream and Aegean blue palette

cards.name: Asterius
cards.fate: A name given by enemies can outlast the one given at birth.
cards.description: Deal 5 damage to a chosen foe.
cards.art: a great bull-headed man in heavy bronze shoulder plates holding a double axe, horns scarred, maze walls and dark arch behind him, oxblood and bronze palette

cards.name: Ariadne
cards.fate: A way out is only useful to someone who intends to return.
cards.description: Read the enemy's next intent. Draw a card and gain 1 Favor.
cards.art: a young woman with a star crown holding a ball of red thread that runs out of frame, sea cliff and a distant ship behind her, wine red and midnight blue palette

cards.name: Icarus
cards.fate: The height is real. So is the fall, and it costs the same.
cards.description: Deal 5 damage to a chosen foe.
cards.art: a youth with wide feathered wings, some feathers melting and falling away, a great sun disc behind him, sea far below, sky blue and molten gold palette

cards.name: Medusa
cards.fate: A face that cannot be looked at is still a face that wants witness.
cards.description: Deal 3 damage and delay the target's next attack.
cards.art: a sorrowful woman with serpent hair, holding a polished bronze shield that shows her own reflection, sea caves behind her, stone grey and verdigris palette

cards.name: Scylla
cards.fate: The sea keeps no record of which side of the strait was right.
cards.description: Deal 4 damage to a chosen foe.
cards.art: a monstrous woman rising from surf with hound heads and coiling tentacles at her waist, sea spray and a narrow strait behind her, teal and salt white palette

cards.name: Hecate
cards.fate: A door is a question, and every key is an answer with a price.
cards.description: Read the enemy's next intent. Draw a card.
cards.art: a veiled goddess holding three burning torches and a ring of keys, two hounds at her feet, a crossroads of cypress behind her, black and old gold palette

cards.name: Melinoë
cards.fate: The dead may be honoured without being obeyed.
cards.description: Restore 4 Will.
cards.art: a young woman half lit and half in shadow holding twin torches, one pale and one dark, faint procession of ghosts behind her, ghost lilac and black palette

cards.name: Nemesis
cards.fate: Justice and revenge share a scale and never share a verdict.
cards.description: Deal 4 damage to a chosen foe.
cards.art: a winged woman in plain armour holding a balance and a short sword, her gaze level and cold, a broken column behind her, slate blue and silver palette

cards.name: Eris
cards.fate: A gift that divides is still a gift, and it is never free.
cards.description: Spend 1 Thread to deal 5 damage. Without Thread, deal 3 and gain 1 Burden.
cards.art: a laughing woman in a torn dark robe holding a single golden apple above a small flame, scattered banquet cups and smoke behind her, bruised purple and gold palette

cards.name: Circe
cards.fate: Being changed is not the same as being less.
cards.description: Deal 2 damage and delay the target's next attack.
cards.art: a sorceress with coiled hair holding a jewelled cup and a staff, swine at her hem, herb bundles and a bronze cauldron behind her, deep green and gold palette

cards.name: Echo
cards.fate: What remains of a voice can still answer for it.
cards.description: Restore 3 Will.
cards.art: a pale nymph fading into stone, lips slightly parted, concentric ripples of sound in the air around her, grey crags behind her, stone grey and sage palette
